page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d2s.5xlarge is a dedicated big data virtual server hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Hardware resources include 20 vCPUs derived from 10 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, complete with AVX-512 vector extensions. The instance is allocated 88 GB of system memory, providing 4.4 GB per vCPU. Network connectivity provides a 12 Gbps baseline, and the server includes an integrated 62,706 GB local HDD storage volume without any discrete GPU hardware.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent multi-threaded computational capabilities, achieving middle-tier scores across stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core (6550.0), and PassMark CPU metrics (15697.83). Conversely, single-threaded processing reflects lower performance tiers, seen in Geekbench single-core (948.0) and single-threaded gzip compression (19.03 GB/sec). Memory throughput remains standard for its class with uncached large-block read operations reaching 43.35 GB/sec and write speeds of 47.16 GB/sec.

The primary resource profile couples moderate CPU and RAM allocation with an exceptionally dense local HDD array. This hardware tradeoff trades random IOPS and single-thread speed for vast physical storage capacity per compute unit. Consequently, the instance is functionally suited for distributed data storage systems, Apache Hadoop and Spark worker nodes, MapReduce frameworks, log aggregation servers, and batch ETL pipelines processing massive sequential data streams.
